tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind sidebar and content. Dark is the default theme; light is chosen in the profile menu.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, KPI tiles, sidebar, header chips, search field.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Rows inside a card (list rows), inputs, dropdowns, secondary buttons, table row hover.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, hover on surface-2, disabled button fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, dropdowns, chips, select pills and other controls. Cards, tiles, sidebar, tables and table dividers use line-soft. Only 1.2:1 against surfaces, so never rely on it alone to show where an input is; the surface-2 fill carries that.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3 (14.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Everything secondary that people read: labels, sub-lines, table headers, section and nav group labels, placeholders, helper text. Sits on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3 only, 4.5:1 or more on each in both themes. Never on the document (paper) colours.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Only for things that should look switched off or empty: disabled controls, empty states, future steps, decorative marks (chevrons, equation operators). Not for text people need to read. Decided by Royi, 10 Nov 2026. Sits on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3 only. Light (#6A6A6A): 4.6:1 or more on all four. Dark: 3.7:1 on bg down to 3.0:1 on surface-3, on purpose: below the 4.5:1 text minimum, which is allowed only because disabled and decorative items are exempt. Anything people need to read uses text-muted. Never on the document (paper) colours.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected chip, active badges, focus ring. Dark: also accent links, 15.9:1 on bg. Light: a separate, more saturated lime (#EBF740) so it looks as bright on white as #E4F04E does on black; only ever a fill, never text (1.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. Dark 15.2:1; light #2A2A28, 11.6:1, slightly softer than black so labels don't jump forward on white.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and selected chip on hover (lighter accent). on-accent text 16:1. New in the design system: the prototypes had no hover for primary actions.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button and selected chip while pressed (darker accent). on-accent text 12:1. New in the design system.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind accent icons and accent counts (accent text on it: 12.7:1).

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of accent-soft elements.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Positive figures and status (paid, valid, up vs last year). Dark: on good-soft 7.8:1, on surface-2 8.4:1. Light: same hue, 5.0:1 on white, 4.5:1 on good-soft.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of good status pills.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Attention status (late, reorder soon). Dark: text and dots, on warn-soft 8.4:1. Light: only big figures (24px+, 3.4:1), icons and borders; small warn text stays `text` with a warn dot, because any amber dark enough for small text turns brown.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of warn status pills.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Overdue, errors, negative figures. Dark: also notification badges; on bad-soft 5.6:1, on surface-2 5.8:1. Light: text only (5.6:1 on white, 4.6:1 on bad-soft); badges and dots use bad-strong.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of bad status pills and overdue counts.

tokens.name: bad-line
tokens.usage: Border of error fields and bad-soft blocks.

tokens.name: on-bad
tokens.usage: Count text on a bad badge. 3.0:1, below the 4.5:1 text minimum at 10–11px; flagged, #111111 would give 6.2:1.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information status. On info-soft 6.8:1.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of info status pills.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Text of agent-name and custom-role tags. On blue-soft 6.4:1. Distinct from flavour-santorini (#6E7BFF), which is only for the Santorini flavour. Decided by Royi, 10 Nov 2026.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of agent-name and custom-role tags.

tokens.name: flavour-aloha
tokens.usage: ALOHA flavour: dot, stock bars, charts. Never for status.

tokens.name: flavour-gaia
tokens.usage: GAIA flavour: dot, stock bars, charts. Never for status.

tokens.name: flavour-santorini
tokens.usage: SANTORINI flavour: dot, stock bars, charts. Never for UI blue.

tokens.name: flavour-kyoto
tokens.usage: KYOTO flavour: dot, stock bars, charts.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind side panels, sheets and dialogs. The only dimming value.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: Light only: a 1px inset edge on every accent fill (primary buttons, logo mark, avatars, nav counts, done steps) so it keeps its shape on white. Meant to be felt, not seen. None in dark.

tokens.name: nav-selected
tokens.usage: Fill of the current page in the sidebar and rail: one step up from the sidebar, the same as surface-3, in both themes. Light was ink (#171717) until 11 Nov 2026; it was the heaviest thing on the screen and pulled attention from the yellow actions.

tokens.name: on-nav-selected
tokens.usage: Label, icon and secondary count on nav-selected: text colour in both themes (light 15.3:1 on #EDEDED).

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: The one soft stroke: outlines of the main containers (cards, KPI tiles, sidebar, table containers, boxes, phone list cards), every table divider (under the header, between rows, above the footer), and the stroke of secondary buttons, Show all buttons and header chips. Softer than line in light (#ECECEC); the same as line in dark.

tokens.name: secondary-on-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of a secondary button that sits on anything that is not white: the page, a grey row, a tinted banner. Inside a white card it stays surface-2. In dark it is the same as surface-2.

tokens.name: icon-box
tokens.usage: Container behind the icon in list rows (Needs your OK, Needs attention). Light: 80% white over the grey row; the icon is text colour.

tokens.name: bad-strong
tokens.usage: Notification badges and bad status dots. White count on it: 4.8:1 in light.

tokens.name: warn-pill
tokens.usage: Fill of amber status pills (Reorder soon, Payment to confirm, Delivered · not paid). Light: a warm yellow, so the pill reads yellow without brown text.

tokens.name: warn-pill-ink
tokens.usage: Label on warn-pill. Light uses the button ink (11:1); the dot carries the amber.

tokens.name: count-accent
tokens.usage: Fill of the yellow count in Show all buttons and card headers.

tokens.name: count-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Number on count-accent; in light the same ink as button labels (12.8:1).

tokens.name: count-bad
tokens.usage: Fill of the red count in Show all buttons and card headers.

tokens.name: count-bad-ink
tokens.usage: Number on count-bad (5.4:1 in light).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title on desktop. One per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: KPI figures in tiles, stock totals, page title on phone.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Inputs on phone (16px stops iOS zooming in), list-row titles on phone.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text: list-row titles, table cells, buttons, nav items, desktop inputs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, emphasised names in tables.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: KPI labels, chip labels, small buttons, card links.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sub-lines, table headers, status pills, helper text, field labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section labels (sidebar groups, form groups, date group headers). Upper-case in EN and BG; no letter-spacing in HE. The smallest text size in the app: nothing goes below 12px.

paper.note: The printed page: invoice and delivery-note previews only. Never used in the app UI, and the same in dark and light, so these are kept apart from the app colours. Contrast on the page: paper-ink on paper-bg 15.5:1, paper-muted on paper-bg 5.0:1 and on paper-panel 4.5:1, paper-note-ink on paper-note-bg 6.9:1.

tokens.name: paper-bg
tokens.usage: The page of an invoice or document preview.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper-bg (15.5:1).

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the document (5.0:1 on the page, 4.5:1 on paper-panel). A text colour, not a fill.

tokens.name: paper-panel
tokens.usage: Bill-to block and tinted areas on the document.

tokens.name: paper-line
tokens.usage: Rules and table lines on the document.

tokens.name: paper-note-bg
tokens.usage: Note strip on the document (e.g. payment terms).

tokens.name: paper-note-ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper-note-bg.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in pills, label-to-field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in buttons and chips; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Rows inside a card; side padding of small buttons and chips; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections; side padding of default buttons and inputs; card padding on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen edge to sidebar and content on desktop; between sidebar and content; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap above a page's first card row, under the page header.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large gaps: empty states, between unrelated page regions.

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: Screen edge to the sidebar or rail and to the content, from 768 px up. Mirrored in Hebrew.

tokens.name: layout-gap
tokens.usage: Desktop: between sidebar and content.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Between all cards and sections inside the content.

tokens.name: row-gap
tokens.usage: Between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: card-padding
tokens.usage: Inner padding of cards and tiles, equal on both sides (desktop).

tokens.name: page-margin-phone
tokens.usage: Phone (below 768 px): screen edge to content.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status pills, small tags, checkboxes, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, dropdowns, list rows, nav items, icon boxes, quantity box.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, KPI tiles, side panels, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, search field, header icon buttons, count badges, avatars, toggles.

size.note: Heights of tappable controls and icon sizes.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, filter pills, header icon buttons, desktop search, desktop page and row actions, quantity steppers. Meets the 32px minimum for tappable chips.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, dropdowns, nav items, phone search, buttons in side panels.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Main action on phone, bottom action bar.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Status pills and tags (not tappable).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in pills, chips and small buttons; dropdown chevron.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size: nav, buttons, header icon buttons, search.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in list-row icon boxes and empty states.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Width of the accent focus outline, offset 2px, on every focusable element.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Desktop side panel width.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatar on desktop (sidebar user card, header).

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Avatar on phone.

tokens.name: popover-width
tokens.usage: Calendar popover width.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Full sidebar, 1280 px and up.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Icon rail, 768–1279 px. A menu button expands it to the full sidebar over the page.

tokens.name: nav-row
tokens.usage: Menu row height.

shadow.note: Shadows only on layers that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, calendar popover, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Desktop side panel opening from the end side. Mirror the x offset in Hebrew.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: Invoice and document previews.

breakpoint.note: Width ranges agreed in the breakpoint review. CSS variables can't be used inside @media, so use these values directly in media queries.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet starts. Below this: phone layout with the bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: bp-laptop
tokens.usage: Small laptop starts. 768–1023 is tablet: icon rail, cards stack in one column, KPI tiles 2 × 2, column picker on wide tables.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop starts: full sidebar with labels. 1024–1279 uses the icon rail with the desktop layout.
